name: Big Game Hunter
terse: Even on foot, utilize the power of mech weaponry to bag the next quarry.

ranks.name: The Right Tool For The Job
ranks.description: When on foot and standing adjacent to your own mech, you may remove any Auxiliary or Main weapon from its mount on your own mech as a Quick Action. This disables usage of the weapon until you place them back into their mount as a Quick Action. Attacking with this weapon on foot incures +1 Difficulty and can only be done as a Full Action. In addition, due to the difficulty of reloading, all ranged weapons without the Limited trait count as Limited 2. Weapons that gain the trait this way are automatically reloaded when placed back on to their mount. Weapons can be dropped as a Free Action, though requires a Quick Action to pick back up.

ranks.name: Fomorian Familiarization
ranks.description: Weapons used as part of this talent no longer take +1 Difficulty. In addition, you can now demount the weaponry of any mech, including those of enemies.

ranks.name: Herculean Hunter
ranks.description: Against enemies larger than you on foot, gain +1 Accuracy to attack them for each size increment that they're bigger.

description: Sometime when you are without your mech, you have to get a little...creative with the tools you have. Mech weapons were not designed for human hands to hold, but many if not all are designed with humanoid ergonomics.
